name: hinario-idc
description: Ecossistema Hinário IDC — Monorepo (App Mobile Capacitor, Domínio Compartilhado, Firestore Sync e Ferramentas)

scripts.deploy: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --filter @hinario/infra-firebase exec firebase deploy --config ../../firebase.json --only firestore,hosting
scripts.deploy:hosting: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --filter @hinario/infra-firebase exec firebase deploy --config ../../firebase.json --only hosting
scripts.deploy:rules: corepack pnpm --filter @hinario/infra-firebase exec firebase deploy --config ../../firebase.json --only firestore
scripts.emulators: corepack pnpm --filter @hinario/infra-firebase exec firebase emulators:start --config ../../firebase.json --project demo-hinario-idc --only firestore,hosting
